findings.problem: The hint 'one word, said as an invitation' does not rule out the very common one-word verb answers ¡Pasa! (come in) and ¡Dale! (go ahead), which a fluent speaker could easily give instead.
findings.fix: hint: one word, not a verb (not pasa or dale); the same word that means 'forward'

back.es: come in!, go ahead!, forward! (interjection inviting someone to enter or proceed)
back.example: Come in, the door is open!

note: In everyday Latin American speech, ¡Pasa! is probably more common than ¡Adelante! for 'come in', so the hint needs to point the learner clearly to adelante.
